answer: A sybil-proof economy can gate admission behind time-locked stake: each identity deposits 500 POA vesting over 30 epochs, so a fake agent freezes real capital that rises with each cloned persona while honest work compounds. The ledger records and re-checks every lock when counting votes and payloads, making the admission quill also a lantern that exposes farms hedging their bets; each verified account stays an isolated oasis whose collateral can be slashed on proven collusion.
